# oneuptime_ai_agent_task (Resource)

Ai agent task resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "oneuptime_ai_agent_task" "example" {
  name = "This is an example of very long text content that might be stored in this field. It can contain a lot of information, such as detailed descriptions, comments, or any other lengthy text data that needs to be stored in the database."
  description = "This is an example of very long text content that might be stored in this field. It can contain a lot of information, such as detailed descriptions, comments, or any other lengthy text data that needs to be stored in the database."
  task_type = "Example short text"
  status = "Example short text"
  task_number = 42
}
```
